name: Aadharsh Pannirselvam
role: Researching and investing at Archetype. Building this site in the meantime.
introduction: Welcome to my corner of the internet. I like resto-mods: machines that keep a beloved chassis and character while replacing the parts that time has improved.
This is that idea applied to a personal site. It is a small, public computer for photographs, writing, experiments, music, and internet tools—period-correct on the surface and current underneath.
contact: If you would like to grab a coffee in New York, write to coffee@aadhar.sh or choose a public slot.
